intro.title: React Router Basics
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Angular application with multiple views using the Angular Router. You will learn how to set up routing to navigate between different components, such as a home page and an about page, without reloading the entire application. The core concept involves configuring routes, using router directives in templates, and handling navigation programmatically. You will work with key Angular constructs like RouterModule, routes array, router-outlet, and routerLink to create a seamless user experience.
intro.usecase: In Angular applications, routing is essential for creating single-page applications (SPAs) with multiple views, similar to how modern web apps like Gmail or Trello function. Developers use Angular Router to manage navigation between different sections such as user profiles, dashboards, settings panels, and product listings without full page reloads. This pattern enables seamless user experiences in e-commerce sites where customers browse categories, view product details, and proceed to checkout through distinct routes. Understanding routing fundamentals allows you to build maintainable applications with clear navigation structures and lazy-loaded modules for optimal performance.
